issues.quote: Review 30 days after launch, requesting rooftop first; if median wait does not fall, rollout stops.
issues.concern: The pull-back rule is judged at the one rooftop whose replies we cannot see. His reps reply from VinSolutions (E13), CRM activity is read nowhere (Q18), and one-click clears do not stop the wait clock. So there the median hours to first human reply can only fall if reps change where they reply. A flat number there would stop the rollout for the wrong reason, and a falling one would only tell us reps moved into the console. The stop rule is right; the test rooftop and the measure have to match.
issues.because: E13, E16; one-pager v3 'pre-UI baseline misses CRM-sent replies'; Risks 'CRM activity, unknown [Q18]'
issues.ask: One line: the 30-day review runs at a rooftop where replies are seen (console-only reps, or CRM activity read); at the requesting rooftop, until CRM activity is read, report the click-clear time per owner as a separate check, not the gating number. Not blocking; the PM can set this at Gate 2.

issues.quote: Texts only where we see replies (CRM read, or console-only reps); failures counted.
issues.concern: Read with 'none is connected today' and E13, the requesting rooftop gets no manager texts and no 'mine' on day one: it gets a team Unanswered list cleared by one click. The TL;DR says 'a team view with escalation'. That is true at console-only rooftops, not at the store that asked. I would rather the dealer hears that from us now than finds it in week one.

issues.quote: Cost: manager cross-checking and hours a customer waits at the AI-to-salesperson handoff, on about 600 leads a month (dealer-stated), unpaid and unmeasured; service RO value unknown [E10, E16, E37, Q15].
issues.concern: Hours to first human reply is the right handoff measure, but it is not yet a P&L line I can say to a dealer group in 60 seconds. Nothing in evidence ties wait hours to appointments set or ROs opened, so I do not want a number invented. I do want the baseline query to produce that link, or the PRD will still be selling response time.
issues.ask: For the PRD: run the Q15 baseline split by appointment set (sales) and RO or booking (service, where read) for customers answered inside versus outside N hours, so the value line is stated in appointments or ROs per rooftop from our own data, attributed as Spyne data.
